title: Upload size investigation distinguishes large repository history from the small pending commit
summary: Local Git inspection found 8183 tracked files totaling about 280.1 MiB of content, including a 76.77 MiB APK; the local object pack is about 128.73 MiB. Commit a7a12ad is one commit ahead of the local origin/main tracking reference c98779b. Its new reachable objects total about 0.183 MiB uncompressed relative to that reference; copied reference files mostly reuse existing blobs. Actual network progress, remote state, and retries have not been inspected. No push, deletion, or history rewrite was performed.

evidence.description: Read-only tracked-file size inspection; no file contents or credentials exported.
Compared outgoing object metadata with the local remote-tracking baseline; this does not verify the remote server.

nextSteps: Obtain the upload progress line to distinguish cumulative bytes written, file count, retries, or another upload operation. Do not infer the current commit adds the full repository size.
